mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article) AS article_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `user`) AS user_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment) AS comment_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tag) AS tag_count

SELECT a.id, a.title, u.nickname AS author_name, a.status, a.view_count, a.like_count, a.favorite_count, a.comment_count, a.create_time FROM article a LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = a.user_id ORDER BY a.create_time DESC
